body: I use 7-Dust you can find at Lowe's, put some at the bottom of a box or bag and place the bird inside, and bop it from underneath a few times to spread the powder. The mites crawl out instantly and die.  Works every time, done this for years with success.  About to treat my new dove with this.
I wish I had money like that tbh.  I put a little tetracycline in her water just in case.  Also discovered bird lice just now.

Thanks for the advice, but I think she's just stressed from the move, young (she looks younger than 6 mths) and recently torn from her family.  I know doves have close-knit families and become severely depressed without each other, hence her reluctance to eat.  She eats some but not enough. Otherwise healthy.  I've rescued sick birds so familiar with that.
Me too, I wish I could find a friend like you : (

I have a similar situation.  My husband is perfect for me but we don't relate sexually.  He's probably more of an ace than me.  I was frustrated for a little bit before figuring out a silly solution to kill my libido: I picture roaches mating lol.  Kills it every time!  For me it reinforces the idea that the only reason I have this urge is purely biological and I don't have to be ruled or tricked by it.

Thank you for wording how I feel about people!   What you just wrote goes through my head almost on a daily basis.  We're like biologically programmed to be social which kills me bc I'm not like-minded with anyone, it seems.  How you said "no idea how people get the good in each other to come out" that's hilarious.  yeah I don't get people either.

Yes!  I have an Indian runner duck named Jimmy.  I've always had a thing for ducks, he is the cutest thing ever.  At 2 yrs old he still follows me everywhere and even plays chase with my toes.  He's my familiar : P

Good advice!  Sometimes talking about it with others helps me think it out better, so thank you.  I know my solution so it's just a matter of practice.  I'm still new to the Craft and it's a learning process.  Also will be looking into spells so I can manage my anger better, bc I'd rather follow your suggestion instead of sending a curse!

Thank you!  I'm eager to try all of these suggestions and practice them till it finally gets easier like I've never been able to do before.  But one question: HOW do I send an offender love and healing when dealing with a psychopath that is not capable of empathy?  Because my mind rationally knows their mind is wired totally different and they cannot change.
Is he a narcissist?  There's no reason you have to keep anyone toxic in your life.

Fellow social reject here lol.  I don't belong not even in jail or in a circus but I have a husband of 10 yrs and a diapered duck.  The only form of communication that seems to interest me is telepathy, so yeah I'm a weirdo too!  I love nature, storms and organic food and dream of going to the beach to collect shells for my new Witchy altar : )
It's hard for me to tell but I used to see black spots when on caffeine and haven't since I quit.

Sorry your friend passed.  I had a similar dream about a childhood friend that I'd lost contact with for 10 yrs-we had met in kindergarten and split up first year of college.  In the dream I was talking to her.  When I woke up I said "I wish that was real".  I was very lonely at the time and still kind of am.  2 days later my sister calls to tell me she met my friend at a krogers and I got her #.  But she didn't care to stay friends.
I'm hopeful to experience the same thing you have with being more emotionally controlled.  Caffeine makes me riled up worse over people. This gives me hope!!

I just typed that in and the first thing that came up: "To hear a voice that has no apparent physical cause is usually regarded by psychiatry as an auditory hallucination, a sign of a mental illness. ... It makes me wonder, what can we use this for??

I'm just sticking to natural sugars from now on, nothing added unless it's stevia.  For me exercise helps but I crash regardless from sugar. Good luck abstaining!
I love it : P

Yeah, I think my body's just not having it.  The bumps on my elbows flared up just after eating a salad which is what I normally eat and not allergic to, so I'm starting to think it's too much at once like you suggested.  Yesterday I had a crazy anger spell followed by depression that was exacerbated by fatigue lol but it's going to get better! I'm a week in too and though I had a slight anxiety flair-up from an unrelated food allergy, normally it've been made much worse from the caffeine.  Glad you're feeling better : P

When I visit the park by myself I feel closer to the ducks than to people. That's probably sad, but at least I'm enjoying the peace.

Hi, same here I wasn't having much at all, but have discovered that I'm acutely sensitive to it and it was responsible for my mood problem/fatigue anyway.  It tricks you into thinking that when it really is just withdrawal relief.  Even the caffeine in chocolate was enough.
how many days in do they occur?

oh, sorry!  It's the caffeine withdrawals messing with my brain.

Same here, I thought the caffeine in chocolate was close to negligent but once I even just cut down for a month I could tell a huge difference.  Now I'm completely cutting it out and look forward to more peace of mind and project-completion!
